scope: Additional gameplay-acquired AH Toy Box items for Drops > Toys, Classic through Midnight

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Classic Burning Crusade toys auctionable Orb of Deception World Enlarger
expansionReview.finding: Four outputs: rare world drop, rare-schematic craft and two specialist transport devices.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Burning Crusade toys auctionable transporters Crashin Thrashin Robot schematic
expansionReview.finding: Three crafts. Use Outland skill requirements, not old combined Engineering 350.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Wrath toys crafted AH MOLL-E Wormhole Generator Northrend Timofey
expansionReview.finding: Two crafts from Northrend trainers. Rituals of the New Moon is an off-hand item, not a Toy Box toy.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Cataclysm Gnomish Gravity Well Loot-A-Rang trainer retail engineering
expansionReview.finding: Two crafts with distinct crafting and use skill requirements. Gravity Well belongs to Cataclysm despite its low item ID.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Wormhole Generator Pandaria Sally Fizzlefury recipe coordinates
expansionReview.finding: One crafted output. Trainer marker identifies acquisition, not the random teleport destination.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Draenor Engineering World Shrinker Findle Wormhole Coin Many Faces
expansionReview.finding: Three crafts and one seasonal enemy drop. Non-toy consumables and bound Jewel of Hellfire omitted.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Legion toys crafted Blingtron Circuit Design Tutorial Leather Love Seat Wormhole Argus
expansionReview.finding: Three crafts; complete Short Circuit stops and all five Argus readings mapped. Shoe Shine Kit is bound.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Battle Azeroth Wormhole Generator Kul Tiras Zandalar Nazjatar trainers
expansionReview.finding: Two crafts; both faction trainers and the Nazjatar story unlock retained.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Shadowlands crafted toys auction house Wormhole Generator Dar Vattish
expansionReview.finding: One craft. Requires Honored Undying Army and skill 70 to learn its recipe, skill 1 to use the finished toy.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Dragonflight toys crafted auction house Atomic Recalibrator Environmental Emulator Wyrmhole
expansionReview.finding: Three crafts. Novelties ranks retained; optional Wyrmhole transmitter and compass upgrades mapped separately.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: War Within toys crafted Filmless Camera Wormhole Generator Khaz Algar
expansionReview.finding: Two crafts. Finished toys are separate from prototypes; discovery is not a guaranteed trainer purchase.

expansionReview.representativeQuery: Midnight toys auction house crafted Wormhole Generator Quel Thalas Recycling
expansionReview.finding: One crafted toy. Recycling discovery and current Silvermoon map used.
